whatIs: CallToInspiration is a gallery of site and app interfaces organized by design pattern: logins, popups, tables, forms, dashboards, pricing pages, footers, and more.
You browse it by choosing a pattern category. It's useful when you already know which component you need and want to see how other products handle it.
uses: Comparing several pricing pages before laying out your SaaS's.
Looking at login and sign-up forms to decide fields, order, and error messages.
Finding examples of dashboards and data tables to define the hierarchy of your panel.
caveats: There's no search or filters beyond the pattern categories.
It's visual reference only: it doesn't include code or reusable components.
The homepage has a prominent ad space.
pricingNote: Free to browse, with no paid plans.
idealFor: Seeing how a specific interface component is handled.
